priority_issues.title: Raw Technical Provenance Dump in Audit Fragilities
priority_issues.why_it_matters: Monolithic red text wall displaying raw technical provenance tokens causes severe cognitive overload and degrades executive dossier credibility
priority_issues.fix: Parse pontos_fracos into structured sub-blocks with criterion names, conflicting claims, clickable source links, and correction directives

priority_issues.title: Omission of Research Subject / Theme
priority_issues.why_it_matters: User monitoring long executions loses orientation on which topic is being investigated
priority_issues.fix: Render query-banner displaying plan.tema at the top of ExecutionView

priority_issues.title: Temporal Ambiguity in Multi-Cycle Self-Healing
priority_issues.why_it_matters: Showing active search banner alongside red reproval badge from prior cycle leads users to believe research failed fatally
priority_issues.fix: Add contextual banner labeling prior cycle audit results and dimming them during active search

priority_issues.title: Opaque Mystery Criteria Pills (1..12)
priority_issues.why_it_matters: Pill numbers give no glanceable information on why a criterion failed; hover tooltips fail on touch
priority_issues.fix: Add concise semantic labels to criteria pills

priority_issues.title: In-Card Execution Control and Backend Abort Gap
priority_issues.why_it_matters: Navbar allows client research reset with confirmation, but ExecutionView lacks an in-card stop action and backend has no cancellation endpoint for synchronous jobs
priority_issues.fix: Add in-card secondary action to discard current research and plan backend cancel endpoint for Checkpoint 2
